svg.title: Stratigraphy of a Stack
svg.desc: Geological cross-section of a technology stack, oldest at the bottom: bedrock (Linux, Bash, networking, C), cloud (AWS, Azure), infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Boto3), containers (Docker, Kubernetes, kind, EKS), delivery (Git, Jenkins, Argo CD), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch) and, newest on top, intelligence (Python, LLM agents, MCP). The layers are folded and offset by a fault; two boreholes carry rising particles upward through every layer.

g.text: you can’t reconcile what you can’t see.
the repository is the source of truth.
